main_text.l: Morine, ac pro me Deum precare.

l.i: leges quæ in sepofito folio addere ausus

main_text.l: Admodum Reverendo P. P. Joanni Morino
cidere solent neque ego promptiori ma-
nu calamum unquam arripio, quam cùm
ad te Vir clarissime, scribendi occasio
se mihi præbet; quod ideo significandum
duxi, ut vel hinc intelligas, quanto te
res virtutes faciam. Patrem Goezaldo ad nos redeuntem, qui tuas mihi reddidit, libeu-

page.notes: The initial A is a large woodcut letter, transcribed as "ADmodum" with [?] because the m is hard to separate from the n-like strokes. The word "sepofito" is printed in this form. The space before the semicolon after "Pater" is as printed. The text continues on the next page after "libeu-".
